supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~1e-252; dominant driver.
Interaction coef 0.749, p~1.5e-18, delta R2 0.074 in the pairwise model; holdout test R2 rises from 0.772 (X1-X5 main effects) to 0.878 when X4:X5 is added, and X1+X2+X3+X4:X5 alone gives 0.873.

interaction_claims.reason: Strong significant product term; large out-of-sample gain (test R2 0.77 to 0.88). X4 and X5 are nearly uncorrelated (r=0.037), and their main effects are small, so the effect is a genuine interaction rather than a main-effect artifact.
Interaction p=0.10, delta R2 0.0018; not significant.

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression and holdout evidence only; no design to establish causation.
Strong association but no causal identification.
Matters only through interaction with X5; no causal claim warranted.
Matters only through interaction with X4; no causal claim warranted.
